route.sub: 1 night · Grand Hyatt DFW, Terminal D (points)

days.title: Miami → Dallas (DFW), night at the Grand Hyatt in Terminal D

blocks.title: Lunch at home
blocks.detail:
• Light lunch before leaving.
• Dinner is at the airport hotel tonight.

blocks.title: Final bag check
blocks.detail:
• All 4 passports in one pouch (US passports: no visa needed for Japan, stays up to 90 days).
• Visit Japan Web QR codes saved on your phone (immigration + customs).
• Warm layers in carry-ons: Tokyo is in the 40s–50s °F.

blocks.title: Uber XL home → MIA, American departures
blocks.detail:
• From: home in Miami Springs.
• To: MIA, American Airlines departures level.
• ~10 min drive; 15-min block for loading bags.
blocks.notes: • ~USD 25 for Uber XL incl. tip — estimated.

blocks.title: American check-in and bag drop — check bags only to Dallas
blocks.detail:
• This flight is a separate ticket from the Japan flight, so bags go to DFW only.
• You collect them tonight and recheck them with JAL tomorrow.

blocks.title: TSA PreCheck → walk to the gate
blocks.detail:
• PreCheck lane for all four.
• Refill water bottles after security.

blocks.title: Board AA3267
blocks.detail:
• Boarding ~30 min before departure.
• Last bathroom stop at the gate.

blocks.title: American AA3267 - MIA → DFW - Nonstop - 3h20m
blocks.detail:
• Departs 3:30 PM Miami, lands 5:50 PM Dallas (Dallas is 1 hr behind Miami).
• Economy, 4 passengers.
• Booked with Alaska miles on American (Alaska and American are partners).
blocks.flag: Separate ticket from the Japan flight — claim bags at DFW and recheck them with JAL.
blocks.notes:
• Award price seen on seats.aero for Oct 2027 dates (the latest bookable): 7,500 Alaska miles + USD 25.60 per person × 4 = 30,000 miles + USD 102.40.
• Dec 15, 2027 opens for award booking around Jan 18, 2027.
• Times are the Oct 2027 schedule; December times may shift.
• Same flight on AAdvantage is also possible if Alaska space disappears.

blocks.title: Land DFW — deplane and baggage claim
blocks.detail:
• American domestic flights usually arrive at Terminal A, C or E.
• Follow signs to baggage claim for AA3267 and collect all bags.

blocks.title: Get to Terminal D and the Grand Hyatt
blocks.detail:
• From: your arrival terminal baggage claim.
• To: Terminal D — the Grand Hyatt is built into Terminal D.
• Take the free landside shuttle between terminals (ask at baggage claim), or a short taxi if bags are heavy.

blocks.title: Grand Hyatt DFW — check in
blocks.detail:
• Inside Terminal D, the same terminal JAL departs from tomorrow.
• Room: 2 Queen Beds for the four of you.
• Globalist: free breakfast tomorrow at Grand Met.
blocks.address: 2337 S International Pkwy, DFW Airport, TX
blocks.notes:
• Category 5: 20,000 points for a standard room (seats.aero, Dec 2027 dates). Cash rate seen: USD 337.
• Dec 2027 is already bookable on hyatt.com.
• Confirm 2 Queen Beds when booking.

blocks.title: Dinner — Grand Met (Grand Hyatt DFW)
blocks.detail:
• The hotel restaurant, a short walk from the room.
• No kids' menu: pasta and the burger work for the kids.
blocks.notes:
• Line items (verified, current online dinner menu): Seared Bell & Evans chicken breast USD 38 + Campbell River salmon USD 42 + kids: Harvest Bucatini USD 29 + Grand House Burger USD 25 = USD 134.
• +8.25% Texas sales tax = USD 11.06; +20% automatic service charge (checks of USD 100 or more) = USD 26.80.
• Total ≈ USD 171.86. No extra tip needed.

blocks.title: Bedtime routine — lights out 9:15
blocks.detail:
• Wake-up 7:15 AM.
• Lay out flight clothes tonight.

days.title: Dallas → Tokyo on Japan Airlines JL11

blocks.title: Wake up, showers, flight clothes
blocks.detail:
• Soft, layered clothes for a 13.5-hr flight.
• Kids' headphones, tablets and chargers in carry-ons.

blocks.title: Breakfast — Grand Met (Globalist, free)
blocks.detail: • Full breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids included with Globalist.

blocks.title: Walk to JAL check-in, Terminal D
blocks.detail:
• From: the hotel lobby.
• To: Terminal D departures (ticketing) level — JAL's counters are in Terminal D, no train needed.

blocks.title: JAL check-in and bag drop
blocks.detail:
• International flight: agent checks all 4 passports.
• Check-in opens about 3 hrs before departure.

blocks.title: Security → gate
blocks.detail:
• Use PreCheck if it prints on the boarding passes.
• Refill water bottles after security.

blocks.title: Gate, snacks, board JL11
blocks.detail: • Boarding starts about 40 min before departure.

blocks.title: Japan Airlines JL11 - DFW → HND - Nonstop - 13h30m
blocks.detail:
• Departs 11:50 AM Dallas, lands Friday afternoon at Tokyo Haneda.
• Tokyo is 15 hrs ahead of Dallas, so you lose a day crossing the date line.
• Airbus A350-1000, Japan Airlines' newest long-haul plane. Two full meals included.
• Try to sleep in the second half of the flight so the kids are tired at Tokyo bedtime.
blocks.flag: December schedule not published: in Oct 2027 JL11 lands 3:20 PM; with Dallas off daylight time it would land about 4:20 PM.
blocks.notes:
• Award price seen on seats.aero for Oct 2027 dates: 37,500 Alaska miles + USD 25.60 per person × 4 = 150,000 miles + USD 102.40, with 9 seats showing.
• AAdvantage priced the same flight at 35,000 miles + USD 5.60 per person.
• Dec 16, 2027 opens for award booking around Jan 19, 2027.
• Business class on JL11 rarely shows for partner miles; keep checking after booking economy.
• American's own DFW → HND (AA175) priced at 114,500 AAdvantage miles — not worth it.

days.title: Land at Haneda → Grand Hyatt Tokyo

blocks.title: Land HND Terminal 3 — immigration, bags, customs
blocks.detail:
• Show the Visit Japan Web QR codes at immigration and customs.
• 60 min gate-to-curb is realistic with checked bags.
• Get cash yen from a 7-Bank ATM in the arrivals hall.

blocks.title: Taxi van Haneda → Grand Hyatt Tokyo
blocks.detail:
• From: Terminal 3 arrivals taxi stand.
• To: Grand Hyatt Tokyo, Roppongi Hills (~40 min, longer at rush hour).
• Ask for a large taxi (jumbo) for 4 people plus suitcases.
blocks.notes:
• ~JPY 9,500 incl. expressway tolls ≈ USD 60 — estimated. No tipping in Japan.
• Alternative: the Airport Limousine Bus stops at the Grand Hyatt (~40 min) for less, but runs less often.

blocks.title: Grand Hyatt Tokyo — check in
blocks.detail:
• Inside Roppongi Hills, a covered walk from Roppongi subway station.
• Room: Grand Executive Suite (sleeps 4) via a Suite Upgrade Award on a standard award booking.
• Globalist: free breakfast every morning at The French Kitchen.
blocks.roomType: Grand Executive Suite (via Suite Upgrade Award)
blocks.flag: No standard award space showing yet for Dec 17–22 — check hyatt.com and ask your Hyatt concierge.
blocks.notes:
• Category 8: 35,000–45,000 points a night by date; 200,000 is a 5-night estimate (about 40,000 a night).
• Standard rooms don't fit 4; the Grand Executive Suite does. Apply the Suite Upgrade Award when booking.
• Kids under 12 stay free in the parents' room.
• Tokyo lodging tax (3% from Apr 2027) may be charged at the hotel.

blocks.title: Dinner — in-room dining
blocks.detail:
• Easiest on arrival night: kids eat in pajamas.
• The hotel's in-room kids' menu includes fried shrimp and pan-fried fish.
blocks.notes:
• Line items: kids' deep-fried shrimp JPY 1,870 × 1 + kids' pan-fried fish JPY 1,870 × 1 (verified, hotel's family page) + 2 adult mains ~JPY 4,000 each (estimated) = JPY 11,740.
• +15% hotel service charge (estimated) = JPY 13,501 ≈ USD 85. Tax is usually included in Japanese menu prices.

blocks.title: Bedtime routine — lights out 8:30
blocks.detail: • Expect jet-lag wake-ups around 3–4 AM the first nights; keep the room dark.

days.title: Asakusa, Senso-ji and the river boat to Hama-rikyu

blocks.title: Breakfast — The French Kitchen (Globalist, free)
blocks.detail: • 2nd floor of the hotel. Jet lag makes an early start easy today.

blocks.title: Showers and get ready
blocks.detail: • Warm jackets: Tokyo mornings in December are in the low 40s °F.

blocks.title: Taxi to Kaminarimon gate, Asakusa
blocks.detail:
• From: hotel main entrance.
• To: Kaminarimon (Thunder Gate), Asakusa (~30 min).

blocks.title: Senso-ji Temple
blocks.detail:
• Tokyo's oldest and most famous Buddhist temple.
• Enter under Kaminarimon's giant red paper lantern.
• Waft incense smoke from the big burner in front of the main hall (said to bring good health), and draw an omikuji fortune for ¥100.
• Early morning beats the crowds. Free entry.
• Saturday is busier than a weekday — arriving before 9 AM matters.

blocks.title: Nakamise Street
blocks.detail:
• The 250 m lane of small shops between the gate and the temple: toys, crafts, fresh rice crackers.
• Most stalls open around 9–10 AM.

blocks.title: Walk to Daikokuya Tempura
blocks.detail:
• From: the middle of Nakamise Street.
• Turn west onto Denboin-dori and walk ~2 min; Daikokuya is at 1-38-10 Asakusa.
• Join the line before the 11:00 AM opening.

blocks.title: Lunch — Daikokuya Tempura
blocks.detail:
• Asakusa's best-known tempura shop since 1887: shrimp tempura over rice (tendon) with a dark, sweet sauce.
• Kids eat the shrimp tendon; no kids' menu.
• There is usually a line at meal times.
• Saturday lines run longest — be in line by 10:45 for the 11:00 opening.
blocks.notes:
• Line items (prices from an April 2025 review, estimated): Tendon B (2 prawns + mixed) JPY 2,500 + Ebi-Tendon C (4 prawns) JPY 2,700 + kids: Tendon A JPY 2,300 × 2 = JPY 9,800 ≈ USD 62.
• Current menu not confirmed. No tipping in Japan.

blocks.title: Walk to Asakusa Pier
blocks.detail:
• From: Daikokuya.
• Walk east past Kaminarimon to the Sumida River; the Tokyo Cruise pier is at the foot of Azuma Bridge (~10 min).

blocks.title: Water bus Asakusa → Hama-rikyu Gardens
blocks.detail:
• Sightseeing boat down the Sumida River under Tokyo's bridges (~35 min).
• The fare includes Hama-rikyu Gardens admission.
blocks.flag: Only about 3 boats a day on this route — confirm the departure time and adjust lunch around it.
blocks.notes:
• Fares (GO TOKYO): adult JPY 1,180 × 2 + child JPY 470 × 2 = JPY 3,300 ≈ USD 21.
• Hama-rikyu is drop-off only; you can't board there.

blocks.title: Hama-rikyu Gardens
blocks.detail:
• A former shogun's garden on Tokyo Bay, with ponds fed by seawater and a teahouse on an island.
• Easy flat paths with skyscrapers behind the pines.
• Open 9 AM–5 PM.

blocks.title: Taxi Hama-rikyu → hotel
blocks.detail:
• From: the garden's Otemon gate taxi stand.
• To: Grand Hyatt Tokyo (~15–20 min).

blocks.title: Rest at the hotel
blocks.detail: • Hotel pool: kids 4–15 allowed 9 AM–7 PM.

blocks.title: Walk to Gonpachi Nishi-Azabu
blocks.detail:
• From: hotel main entrance.
• Walk out to Roppongi-dori and head southwest (downhill) about 650 m to the Nishi-Azabu crossing.
• Gonpachi is the large wooden building on the corner.

blocks.title: Dinner — Gonpachi Nishi-Azabu
blocks.detail:
• A big wooden izakaya styled like an old Edo inn (the inspiration for a famous Kill Bill fight scene).
• Charcoal-grilled yakitori, soba noodles and rice bowls.
• Kids: oyako-don (chicken and egg over rice) and chicken skewers.
blocks.notes:
• Line items (online menu, undated — estimated): stone-pot unagi rice JPY 1,580 + duck seiro soba JPY 1,450 + kids: oyako-don JPY 800 × 2 = JPY 4,630; +10% for price increases = JPY 5,093 ≈ USD 32.
• Book ahead for an early table; dinner may add a small table charge.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • Same route in reverse: uphill on Roppongi-dori to Roppongi Hills (~10 min).

blocks.title: Bedtime routine — lights out 7:30
blocks.detail: • Wake-up 6:00 AM tomorrow.

blocks.title: Taxi to Meiji Jingu (Harajuku entrance)
blocks.detail:
• From: hotel main entrance.
• To: Jingu-bashi bridge next to JR Harajuku Station (~15 min).

blocks.title: Walk to the shrine
blocks.detail:
• From: Jingu-bashi bridge.
• Pass under the first giant wooden torii gate and follow the wide gravel path north through the forest (~10 min).

blocks.title: Meiji Jingu
blocks.detail:
• Tokyo's most important Shinto shrine, built for Emperor Meiji, inside a planted forest of about 100,000 trees.
• Rinse hands at the water basin, see the wall of sake barrels, and write a wish on a wooden ema plaque.
• Free entry; quiet in the morning.

blocks.title: Walk to Yoyogi Park
blocks.detail:
• From: the main shrine.
• Walk back south to the Harajuku entrance, then follow signs west to Yoyogi Park's Harajuku Gate (~12 min).

blocks.title: Yoyogi Park
blocks.detail: • Big open lawns and a pond: room for the kids to run before the crowds of Harajuku.

blocks.title: Walk to Takeshita Street
blocks.detail:
• From: Yoyogi Park Harajuku Gate.
• Walk back past JR Harajuku Station to its Takeshita exit; Takeshita Street starts across the road (~8 min).

blocks.title: Takeshita Street
blocks.detail:
• A narrow pedestrian street of colorful shops, candy and crepe stands.
• Packed on Sundays — hold hands.

blocks.title: Walk to Maisen Aoyama
blocks.detail:
• From: the bottom (Meiji-dori) end of Takeshita Street.
• Turn right on Meiji-dori, then left onto the wide Omotesando avenue; walk ~6 min and turn left into the side street to 4-8-5 Jingumae (~12 min total).

blocks.title: Lunch — Tonkatsu Maisen Aoyama
blocks.detail:
• Tokyo's classic tonkatsu (breaded pork cutlet) house, in a converted old public bathhouse.
• Has a real kids' set: small cutlet with rice and soup.
• Open 11:00 AM–10:00 PM.
blocks.notes:
• Line items (prices from another Maisen branch's menu — estimated): loin cutlet set JPY 1,530 + fillet cutlet set JPY 1,530 + kids' set JPY 1,000 × 2 = JPY 5,060; +20% for the Aoyama flagship = JPY 6,072 ≈ USD 38.
• Prices include tax. Aoyama menu not confirmed.

blocks.title: Subway Omotesando → Shibuya (Ginza line, 2 stops)
blocks.detail:
• From: Maisen, walk ~4 min to Omotesando Station Exit A2.
• Ginza line toward Shibuya, 2 stops (~3 min). Tap Suica/PASMO.
blocks.notes: • ~JPY 180 per adult, half for kids ≈ JPY 536 total ≈ USD 3 — estimated.

blocks.title: Shibuya Crossing and Hachiko
blocks.detail:
• The famous scramble crossing, where every direction crosses at once.
• Start at the Hachiko statue (the loyal dog) by the station exit, cross with the crowd, then watch from the Shibuya Mark City walkway above.

blocks.title: Miyashita Park rooftop
blocks.detail:
• Free rooftop park on top of a low shopping building, a 5-min walk north of the station along the tracks.
• Lawn, benches and city views; a break before dinner.

blocks.title: Walk to Uobei Shibuya Dogenzaka
blocks.detail:
• From: Miyashita Park.
• Back south past the crossing, then up Dogenzaka hill; Uobei is at 2-29-11 Dogenzaka (~10 min).

blocks.title: Early dinner — Uobei sushi
blocks.detail:
• Kids order on a touch screen and plates race to the seat on a high-speed track.
• Cooked choices for picky eaters: fried chicken, egg (tamago), corn-mayo rolls.
• Open 11 AM–11 PM; going early avoids the evening line.
blocks.notes: • Estimated: ~32 plates at ~JPY 150 average = JPY 4,800 ≈ USD 30. Older reviews list JPY 110 per plate; current prices not confirmed.

blocks.title: Taxi Shibuya → hotel
blocks.detail:
• From: Dogenzaka (hail on the main road).
• To: Grand Hyatt Tokyo (~15–20 min).
